title: Talk 1
original: There are no famiglie in Nuova Volsinii, not a single one. A famiglia must flip into a corporation before it can enter the city, and that's hardly a bother. Indeed… and there's not much difference between a mafia and a corporation, whether Siracusan or foreign.

title: Talk 2
original: The Bellones took me in when I was five, and trained me to become Leon's consigliere. With this bulky suitcase in tow, I went to many places and met many faces as I ran errands and collected intelligence. Even now, I still do many things myself.

title: Talk 3
original: You want to learn to knuckle-roll a lighter as fast as I do? It's easy, here. Don't worry, just try again. I practice these tricks to keep my hands nimble—after all, there are times when you can't just draw a blade, even in Siracusa.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: At first, the famiglie were just packs of runts keeping each other alive, while the dons used them as tools to grab power. But in Nuova Volsinii, under Leon's rules, a famiglia does imply a real family now—at least, that's how it is for the Bellones.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
